---
name: Compatibility (hardware or software)
about: Tell us what you want to make work, what you tried, or what you tested
title: "[Compatibility] <vendor> <model>"
labels: compatibility
---

**What is it?** (vendor, model, firmware/software version, what role: relay, heater, wallbox, battery, meter, router...)

**How is it commanded and measured?** (Home Assistant entities, MQTT topics, HTTP, Modbus... link to its documentation)

**What did you try with solarprio?** (configuration without secrets, what happened)

**What status can we claim?** Pick the honest one and say what you saw:
- [ ] Verified on real hardware (for how long, with which safety devices in place)
- [ ] Simulated only
- [ ] From the manufacturer's documentation, not run
- [ ] Not tried yet, I would like it to work

**Do you want to contribute it?** See [docs/ADDING_COMPATIBILITY.md](../../docs/ADDING_COMPATIBILITY.md): a tested configuration and a short page is already a contribution, no code needed.
